nom: Good Molecules Sakura Hyaluronic Acid Boosting Essence

avis.titre: Feels So Good On My Skin
avis.texte: Nice step after cleansing. My pores appear smaller. My skin feels good.

avis.titre: This Sakura H.A. is Just Right
avis.texte: I am partial to this product because of my belief in the effectiveness of Cherry Blossoms. After spending 10 years in Japan I am convinced of the results. The product is more effective than previously used Timeless and Ordinary brands.This Sakura Boosting Essence is a constant for me. I am so pleased with the results. Good Molecules is beyond wonderful for my skincare desires.
I will always repurchase this product! it's great for my sensitive skin and is very hydrating

avis.titre: I like this product, it is not drying like some toners.
avis.texte: This product was recommended by an Ulta sales associate. I had noticed my skin being dry and lackluster recently (probably due to inside heat and excessive cold temperatures outside). I asked for a recommendation and she said I would probably like this product and she is correct. It does not dry out my skin like the Clinique product I had been using. As a FYI, I am in my 70's and this product does the job, gently.

`I have consistently been using this toner since last April. I have purchased it again and again because it is one of the best I have ever tried. I skin flood with this toner and I love that I can use a lot without feeling sticky or sweaty. It layers amazing with my other skincare products, does not pill, and creates a glowly, hydrated base before makeup application. I have put multiple friends onto this toner and they love it.

I recommend this product based on my personal use of it for the past six months. I enjoy the hydrating essence it gives to my dry skin. I have very dry skin during the wintertime, and this gives me a great boost of hydration. It was pretty decent during the warmer months as well. I will say I definitely prefer it as a winter toner than a summertime one. Other than that, though, I would recommend this for dry to very dry skin like mine.
I live in Colorado and with the dry winters this is a must have! I am acne prone with dehydrated skin and this didn't break me out. It is also noncomedogenic which I love. Super hydrating and silky.

avis.titre: Love this product, and will buy more when I run out!
avis.texte: Got this product because I heard hyaluronic acid helps with rosacea and redness and I needed a safe and healthy toner. I use an app called Yuka that rates the products you scan and tells you if they are safe or why each ingredient is risky. Most products from this brand rate 100 which is the healthiest/highest rating you can get. I love it!
This is my first time using this toner and I like it. Its light and refreshing on my skin. Never had any breakouts.

avis.titre: Loved the original. New formula a dud.
avis.texte: Used the original formula for a couple of years. Got compliments on my skin and gave recommendations for its use. After using this new formula for a few weeks, my skin flared up with irritation and redness that wouldn't go away. Took awhile to determine what the cause was, but since stopping use of this product, my skin is finally healing. Bring back the original formula. It was great. Won't buy this version again.

I have been using this for about 1 year, this replaced another GOOD MOLECULE Hyaluronic Boosting (which I had used at least 4 years) but they switched to Sakura Hyaluronic acid Boosting serum. I like this.
Although I haven't been using this product for a while, my skin feels smooth after use and absorbs quickly. Great if you want an effective essence but don't want anything crazy.
Had to stop immediately, made my skin burn and break out in itchy red spots

This is the fourth bottle I've purchased. I use it as a toner at night followed by either a retinol oil (also good molecules) or a hydrating essence. I have senitive, breakout prone that is both dry and oily aging skin. This is the only toner I've found that checks all of the boxes my skin needs to stay looking plump and glowy. As long as the formula stays the same, I'll never buy another toner.
I find this product to help with my dryness. I also feel like it helped firm my face also.
The Sakura Hyaluronic Acid Boosting Essence is perfection. I have dry skin, and it makes my skin feel hydrated before I put on the first serum or moisturizer. Don't miss out on this one!
i use this daily or every other day. not too rough on my skin and hydrating!

avis.titre: Seems to hydrate, and is soothing
avis.texte: I enjoy this toner, and actually layer it over (dried) toner. I put it all over my face, except by my eyes, and I think it makes my skin more hydrated. I know that my foundation is looking better, and so's my skin.

Love this new formula. I think the one star reviews saying bring back the old formula is by a single person with 5 different emails. This provides moisturizing humectants before applying an emollient. No redness, no tackiness, and unscented. Love it
I love the smell of this product I do see a difference in my skin
It feels nice on and the hyaluronic acid I put on after absorbs quickly. My face does look brighter after a week even tho I'm 74. Definitely a face must for me.

Love love love that this makes my skin so moisturized and even a little plump + smooth. It works great as a toner to help with abortion of other products too. I follow it with the super peptide serum. I still have 11s, between those two products + wearing frownies at night I find they're much less pronounced and I'm much less bothered by them. Glad to find a Botox alternative that's kinder to my wallet and to myself as I inevitably age.

If you're looking for a hydrating base product, look no further. This essence is the perfect base for any skincare or even before makeup. Every time I use this before bed, I wake up absolutely glowing. I would recommend this to anyone and everyone who wants to have glowy and hydrated skin.

avis.titre: I want to love this…missing the old formula
avis.texte: I was an avid user of the previous version of this product, Hyaluronic Boosting Essence and I LOVED it. Worked so so well for my skin and truly helped me glow. Since I started using this newer version of the product, I've noticed so much redness and irritation all over my face. I thought maybe it was environmental stressors, but as I've continued to use this product, I think I'm realizing something about the new formulation is just sadly not working for my skin :( I will have to find a new toner/essence for my routine which makes me super sad but I still love good molecules and still use many of their other products!
Before makeup before all this works amazing, sking soft and ready for next
This product is so hyrdrating and it doesnt break out my super sensitive skin. I use it to dampen my skin before I add snail mucin and my skin suffers when I dont have it.

I've only used it one time because I had some hyaluronic left to use up.begore I started this one. So far, it seems to keep my oily skin calmer, My skin got very dry in the T zone but my cheeks & chin were oily by the time I finished all of my skincare. But it's the best I've tried so I will keep using. We'll see how it does in the cold.

tried this for a month.. made me breakout and here i am 4 weeks later after not using, still dealing with the breakouts that occurred from this product. i don't recommend. cant even return anymore due to the return policy.
Please bring back the old formula. Dont fix what isnt broken.
Before this was reformulated is was a great product, now it's absolutely horrible.

This is my first time using this serum and so far it's been a nice addition to my moisture routine. I have acne prone oily skin and it is a necessity to keep that skin type moisturized with too much oil based products. This does the good job making my skin look and feel healthy.

I love the Good Molecules product line. I have mature with mild roseacea and this product doesn't irritate my skin. It feels great and makes my skin soft hydrated. Live the glass bottle and the flip top to assure no spillage. It is a great price for the size of the bottle. Good Molecules is a great brand, and I always use their products.

avis.titre: Great addition to skin care regimen
avis.texte: I shake a few drops into my palm, rub my hands together and apply it to my face and chest. I find it soothing and moisturizing. My skin is sensitive and I have no adverse reaction to this product. I tried it when it first came out and have reordered once so far. My skin likes it!

I used to use a lot of good molecule products and loved them. All the reformulated version are awful?? Even tried to give this one a second chance because I missed the original but broke out like crazy from it AGAIN :(

It's amazing - within a few days my face was looking smoother, and some annoying marks (spots?) on my forehead had diminished significantly; also the line between my eyes looks so much less obvious. Skin looks great. So happy.

avis.titre: Still clearing my skin after breaking out
avis.texte: Used this once and broke out. I received as a promo and i never used it again. My skin is still recovering from me trying to use products to clear from breaking out due to this product.

I'm really enjoying this toner as a light hydrating product to use after cleansing. It's a bit sticky after you apply it, but that doesn't last for too long. The hydration doesn't hold for quite as long as I thought it would, but it's very calming and relaxing and it does the job pretty well.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling so soft and smooth
avis.texte: I have been loving mixing this into my morning skin care routine. A fan of the hyaluronic acid serum this is a new go to product for me and switch off between these two.

My skin is much more elastic, firm and bright; I've been using this products for about 1 month by now and the difference in and on my skin is pretty significant, friends asked me about what I've done to my face that looks younger… that's priceless!!

I really love this. Hydrating and my skin drinks it up. No scent. Unlike the other products, you need a good amount of this but it's not terribly expensive so I can get more when I need to without worrying about the cost.
I have repurchased this item three times. I'm not sure if it actually boosts my Hyaluronic Acid serums but it's super hydrating

okay so was not expecting to love this as much as I did! I love how hydrated my skin felt instantly after using, and with continued use my skin literally drinks this up. also a sucker for my products being in glass so this was such a win win in my opinion - not including good molecules always coming through with the affordable pricing! ALSO last note 😝 LOVEEEE that these are made in Korea
Very hydrating & silky, made mu skin feel do much better after being out in the sun.
So happy with all of the products that I purchased! Cruelty free, vegan, and wallet friendly! A co worker guessed I was 28 the other day! I am mid 40s! Thank you!
I am so glad I decided to try this product. I put this on after my toner and before all my serums, and it just makes my face so soft. It's super hydrating. I truly love this product.

This essence is so nice! I use it every morning with the good molecules hyaluronic acid serum. The zinc pca in this reduces my redness and keeps my acne prone skin balanced. It's a great first step before serums for an extra boost of hydration :)

This really is perfect for summer time! Light but still feels like I'm putting on a product which I love. I don't wear makeup often during the summer time and it's a perfect clean product that goes well on before my serums and moisturizers

I'm so happy I added this to my routine. I've been trying out different products to make my skin look dewey. This is one of them that helped a lot. I recommend this to anyone with dry skin and are prone to clogged pores like me.
Impressed by how cleansing and refreshing it felt on my skin. It truly delivered on its promise of leaving my complexion feeling plump and healthy-looking.

avis.titre: The old hyaluronic acid essence works better for me
avis.texte: I have been using the hyaluronic acid essence for over a year and it was a game changer in my routine. The new upgrade leaves my skin dry and rough. Total waste of money and I got 3 bottles!!

I picked this up while traveling to pick up my snail essence, which had started leaking (ugh). Really hydrates my dry skin without being irritating or creating redness. Plays well with my moisturizer without foaming/pilling etc.

The Sakura Hyaluronic Acid Boosting Essence is that product! It leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft immediately after application and continues to work throughout the day. The absorption is unreal—it melts into the skin almost instantly with zero residue, which I truly appreciate. As someone with oily skin, I've noticed a significant reduction in oiliness, especially in the mornings. This essence has made a real difference in my skincare routine. Absolutely a 10/10—highly recommend! Gifted by Good Molecules

I added this into my night time routine; skin flooding. This essence is so hydrating,smells so good and beautifully packaged (even better than the higher end products, on the other side of Ulta). I am so happy I choose this. For reference I have extremely dry skin regardless of what season, and use 4 to 5 different toners/essence a night. I apply this on first; dab and pay motion. My last application is my milky toners to lock it in. I wake up in the morning with GLOWY hydrated skin. Mature dry skin approved. I absolutely love Good Molecules 10/10

Thank you, to Good Molecules and their amazing facial products. I have had the pleasure of using the new Sakura Hyaluronic Acid Boosting Essence serum after trying their Hyaluronic Serum and they both work well together, but the Sakura has made a difference in my skin. I noticed how it makes my face feel soft but firm at the same time. My face actually has a nice glow to it and it feels so refreshing while dabbling it into my skin. I look forward to using it daily and nightly before bed. I absolutely see great results and will continue using it.
Trying them gor the fist time already a week and looove them so far.

The old essence was my favorite skin care product ever . It literally made my skin hydrated and glow all day . Now I hate it . It' is the worst product I've ever tried . My face gets extremely dry and Ashy right after using it and it's making my skin drier by the day . Why try to fix something that wasn't broken ???? Now I'm going to have to search for another holy grail skincare product once again .

avis.titre: Why did they change this product?
avis.texte: This used to work miracles for me in the winter with my auper dry skin, but whatever they changed in the formula over the last minth or two makes my skin peel like crazy. I'm so bummed.

I have a whole regimen of Good Molecules and the Sakura Hyaluronic Acid Boosting Essence has become my number one fave! Leaves my skin feeling so hydrated and glowy and has been the perfect staple for both AM and PM. I look forward to using it every day!
This product has really improved the appearance of my skin. Since I have started using it, my skin has become clearer and brighter. My dark spots are also lighter.
Product feels good on my skin, but i have not noticed any visible smoothness or plumpness while using the hyaluronic acid serum with it.

i may be in the minority in this but i really dislike this reformulation, it isn't as hydrating as the original version yet it made my skin much more oily and prone to closed comodones. i loved the original toner and bought it for years but will no longer be re-purchasing 🫠

The original Hyaluronic Acid Boosting Essence was my favorite. Literally amazing. I used to get so many compliments on my skin. This new Sakura version is NOT it. Its a whole new formula of mostly water and they even removed a few ingredients 😭 I will be returning this 😢
This is my first bottle if this HA. I really like it. It absorbs well without leaving a film or stickiness.

Get this! Im so amazed at how after just one use I woke up to skin so plump and juicy my (light) acne scars were gone!! Has no noticeable scent and feels super refreshing upon application. Will keep in fridge for hot weather relief. Am very impressed with this product and will try some more from this brand for sure!
I really love this product! leaves my skin feeling so soft and hydrated. I have sensitive skin and this has been great

Good molecules sent me this product to review and just because it was free doesn't mean I'm going to lie the product is great it hydrates very well I use it right after I wash and tone my face with witch hazel and it brings moisture back to my face I though it'd have a more serum like consistency but it just feel like water and though it feel dry it's not I'd definitely purchase when it runs out thank you good molecules 💋

I've only had this product for a few days but have really enjoyed it. It smells amazing and provides light moisture with only 3-5 drops of product. It goes on seamlessly under makeup and has replaced my need to additional moisturizers. This time of year my skin is oily; I'm curious to see if it will be enough moisture in the fall/winter when I can be dry, This product will definitely be a repeat purchase for me. Some things you need to know: I am a repeat good molecules customer who regularly uses several of their products. I was given a bottle of the Sakura essence for free in exchange for my review: how ever the review is honest.

This is my first time using an essence instead of traditional toners and I actually am impressed! The essence is very lightweight and absorbs easily into my skin. It has only been a couple days into me using it and I feel like my other products last longer throughout the day. My skin feels more plump and hydrated for a longer time. This is definitely something that I look forward to adding into my skin care routine and can't wait to see how my skin evolves over time! Gifted by Good Molecules

This was my first time using an essence instead of just traditional toners in my skin routine and I am hooked! This essence is lightweight and absorbs easily into my skin. I feel like over the few days that I have been using it, it makes my products last longer. My skin feels moisturized for longer. After my skincare routine, my skin feels plump, soft, and hydrated! I will definitely keep this in my routine and look forward to how my skin continues to evolve and glow! Gifted by Good Molecules

I use this product in the morning to give my skin a hydrating and brightening look. This product is very good for locking in hydration and it makes me skin feel so smooth and plump after using this product. When I apply this product it easily absorbs into my skin giving that brighting and hydrating look. The cherry blossom extract is such a perfect touch in this product. My skin has looked 10 times better because of how hydrating this product gives.

As someone with really dry skin, I love this product!! I used the original formula, so i love this upgrade! Truly no cons. I love layering this with my GM hyaluronic acid serum. Even when i have an occasional breakout, this isn't thick and pore-clogging. It's very lightweight!

avis.titre: I didn't know if needed this !
avis.texte: My mom got me this from ulta and it's been a total game changer . I actually love it more than the hylaronic acid serum because it has zinc in it to help oily skin and acne ! My face feels super refreshed as well using this. Good job good mocules 👏👏

Sorry guys I had wrote a bad review previously! I was so used to the old formula I guess I didn't give this a minute to work!! I think it's actually working better I an seeing a brighter hydrated complexion!! It's only change I've made to my routine and I'm grateful!! I'm loving it now for I love everything from Good Molecules and I'm so glad this worked into my routine with a positive!!
works so well with the acid drops and my face feels so soft and supple
works so well with the acid drops and my face feels so soft and supple

I'm already a huge fan of Good Molecules, but the Sakura Essence has seriously earned a permanent spot in my routine!!! It's the perfect step right after toner—super lightweight, calming, and it gives my skin that fresh, hydrated glow without feeling heavy or sticky!! The cherry blossom extract is so soothing, and my skin has truly been loving the extra boost of hydration! Everything feels smoother, softer, and just overall more hydrated!! The packaging is also so so beautiful, I cannot get over how good it looks on my vanity—Good Molecules you have truly slayed the skincare game yet again!!! **If you're building a skincare routine that actually works, this essence is a must have!**
I thought this would be a step up from tge original but it's making my skin very dry!! I've tried several times and it's same results!! Pkease don't discontinue the original ir works great!!

I've been using this essence twice a day for about a week and really loving it! It has a really light and watery texture that absorbs into my skin fast. When I use the HA serum with it at night time, I notice my skin is so plump and smooth when I wake up. Definitely a staple in my routine now!

As someone who's used a tone of skincare for my sensitive, acne prone, and combo skin, this has been a game changer for me. Using this has helped accelerate the process of my skincare helping my skin and is so easy to use. My skin feels and looks visibly healthier and more hydrated after using this. 10/10 recommend using this one if you're looking for an essence

avis.titre: My dry skin drinks this UP
avis.texte: If you have dry or dehydrated skin - GET THIS! My skin stays hydrated ALL day! The texture is very light and absorbs really quickly with no stickiness. My makeup looks so much smoother too!

I love this essence! I usually use the Fresh rose toner but unfortunately that is becoming a bit out of my budget for me so I wanted to try something new that is budget friendly. Thank GOD GM came out with this essence! It leaves my face SO soft, smooth, and plumped. It does not sting or have any fragrance. I truly recommend it.

Extremely hydrating just on its own. Combined with your skin care routine, it adds that extra touch. I feel more plumped and glowly when I use it. Packaging is super cute too. The bottle dispenses a perfect amount without wasting.
Hydrating and calming. I like it and love the price as well as the cute packaging

avis.titre: Great for oily acne prone skin
avis.texte: Non comedogenic. It sinks into my skin and really helps the tone! Makes a huge difference with my redness! My skin drinks this up!
1. it has very cute packaging and 2. its been very hydrating so far and hasn't given me any bad reaction! works pretty much the same as the old hyaluronic acid essence

avis.titre: This is the only toner I
avis.texte: This is the only toner I use. It is mild, hydrating, and feels very soft on the skin. I put a few drops on my palms and massage it in gently. For a thorough wipe, I use a cotton pad. It's amazing!
